what_to_detect: An embalm ability resolves and creates a token copy of its card (token_created in the effect half).
near_miss: An embalm ability's resolution that creates no token.
record_fields: resolution effect half token_created event (CopyPermanentEffect is a TokenEffectBase)

acting line: the Embalm keyword line, script_api_type Keyword, so api CopyPermanent does not select it; keyword_display_name Embalm does; without either, token_created matches every token in the corpus
